profile.headline: Hardware Validation Engineer
profile.summary:
When your project is stalled by intermittent, hard-to-diagnose hardware or software integration issues, I bring both passion and deep expertise to get you back on track. I thrive on challenges where standard debugging tools fall short, consistently uncovering root causes and delivering lasting solutions—even in the most complex environments.


My toolkit includes:


Deep System Expertise: Extensive experience in embedded systems, firmware, hardware bring-up, and pre- and post-silicon validation for RTOS.
Comprehensive Quality Assurance: Mastery of all software testing disciplines—from unit, integration, and performance testing to the design of robust, cross-platform automation frameworks.
Modern Efficiency: A fast learner who adapts quickly to new technologies and leverages advanced AI tools to accelerate progress, always ensuring results meet the highest standards of quality and reliability.
Solving difficult problems is not just my job—it’s my passion and commitment. I am results-driven, not hours-driven, and I stand by my work with a unique guarantee: you only pay if I deliver a solution. If I cannot resolve your toughest challenges, you owe me nothing.

I am particularly interested in opportunities involving system/hardware validation, SoC development/Post Silicon Validation, or hardware bring-up.

projects.title: 64-bit Synopsys CAD software
projects.description:
Port 32-bit Synopsys CAD software to 64-bit, which consisted of logic simulator, layout tools,
simulation software over different platforms like IBM/AIX, SUN/Solaris over 18 months.
The project was carried by 2-man team.

projects.title: Trusted Oracle
projects.description:
Port Oracle databases to Trusted Oracle running on Sequence hardware.
Validate 100 millions lines of codes for complete Oracle databases and related products.
The project is done by myself over 18 months without any additional help.
